_comment: De-PII'd /v1/billing/balance/detail. Values are raw 'points'. billingSlice.fetchBalanceDetail does Big(availableBalance).div(10000).toFixed(4) => availableCredit. availableBalance 12345600 => '1234.5600', which AccountSummary renders as '$1234.5600' (spec asserts substring 1234.56). Other fields 0/synthetic.
